body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A says '12 నిమిషాలు నడిస్తే' but the walk is 12 minutes, not stated as 'you walk' clearly; more critically, Card A omits the initial 3-minute walk entirely, making the trip instructions incomplete. Card B includes the 3-minute walk to the bus stop, has better flow with 'బయలుదేరి', and 'పుస్తకాలు చదువుకోవచ్చు' is a more natural reason for a library visit than 'చూడవచ్చు'.
